raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo?

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike.

What You'll Be Doing

You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions.

Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation.

For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.

Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants.

You Will…

  • Own frontline operational performance delivered through the in-house Global Escalations team (UK and Georgia) and the outsourced network (3 BPOs, 3 Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents), including the team leads and ops managers within those outsourced functions
  • Lead and develop the Global Escalations team directly, managing our most sensitive and reputation-critical contacts with judgement, empathy, and rigorous root cause analysis
  • Drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, tracked through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like AHT and refund costs
  • Act as the voice of Support to Deliveroo market GMs, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets and representing their priorities back into the function
  • Partner with Support & Operations cross-functional teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that improve the experience for customers, riders, and merchants
  • Design and run performance frameworks that hold BPO and SSC team leads and ops managers accountable for quality, SLA adherence, and CSAT, fostering a culture of partnership rather than pure oversight
  • Standardise processes and playbooks across outsourced partners and sites where it drives consistency, while respecting genuine market and site-specific differences
  • Diagnose and help bring down attrition and quality issues across the outsourced network, working with BPO and SSC leadership on the retention, engagement, and workforce planning changes needed
  • Partner with Product and Technology to shape the roadmap for customer support systems and channel strategy, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and automation across both in-house and outsourced teams
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across HR, Legal, and Policy to ensure service delivery evolves in line with business priorities
  • Drive data-informed improvement through analysis of contact drivers, escalation themes, and customer sentiment, translating insight into action for both Global Escalations and the outsourced network
  • Represent the function at relevant Weekly Business Reviews and senior forums, providing visibility on performance, risk, and recovery across both the in-house team and the outsourced network
  • Participate in the 24/7 Leadership Team on-call rota
  • Shape functional strategy and set OKRs for contact centre Support across Deliveroo markets, growing the remit from directing your own team to leading leaders, in line with DoorDash's Team Management career framework
  • Grow and develop the managers and leaders within your network, including Team Leads inside Global Escalations and the team leads and ops managers at each BPO and Shared Service Centre, building the next generation of people leaders

Skills & Experience You'll Need

  • Extensive contact centre, BPO, or shared service centre leadership experience in a fast-paced, consumer-facing environment
  • Proven experience managing outsourced or vendor relationships at scale, including the team lead and ops manager layer embedded within partner organisations, not just the commercial relationship
  • Experience leading escalations or complaint handling in a reputation-sensitive environment, with strong judgement and the ability to drive recovery from the most sensitive customer moments
  • A track record of bringing consistency and governance across multiple outsourced partners while respecting genuine local and market differences
  • Experience diagnosing and reducing attrition while improving quality, in a large-scale, multi-site support operation
  • A data-driven approach to balancing customer experience (CSAT) against cost metrics such as AHT and refund rate, without trading one off blindly against the other
  • Experience representing a support or operations function to senior commercial stakeholders, such as General Managers or market leadership, taking full accountability for their experience of the function
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy to drive improvements across a multi-sided marketplace
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Policy, and People teams
  • Strong analytical ability, comfortable turning contact driver, escalation, and sentiment data into action
  • Strong people leadership skills, with experience building and developing a dispersed in-house team and driving performance indirectly through partner leadership
  • A self-starter mindset, a can-do attitude, and willingness to be hands-on in a fast-moving, multi-geography environment
  • Proven strategic mindset with a track record of shaping and executing operational strategies across multiple markets and vendors
  • Deep operational understanding, including customer service design, vendor management, and process optimisation
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results in high-volume, complex environments with multiple priorities
  • Experience partnering with Product and Tech to drive tooling, system, and automation improvements
  • A mindset focused on continuous improvement, customer advocacy, and operational excellence
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at a 'leads leaders' level per DoorDash's Levels and Expectations framework (Team Management track): shaping strategy and OKRs beyond your own team, and developing managers who in turn develop their own teams
  • Meets the senior people-leadership bar DoorDash expects at this level: effectively leads a high-performing team, fosters a culture of belonging and engagement, and takes full accountability for the people outcomes of a large, dispersed organisation

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <h2 class="vac_display_field"><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">The deadline for applying to this role is Sunday 29th November 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth.</span></span></strong></h2> <h2><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">About the team</span></span></strong></h2> <p>AISI's Technical Standards and Best Practice team identifies what best practice is needed to manage the most serious risks from frontier AI development and leverages AISI’s position to get it adopted.&nbsp;</p> <p>AI capabilities are advancing faster than the science and practices used to manage their risks. Risks now emerge earlier, during training, internal deployment and evaluation, not just at public release, and evaluation methods are struggling to keep pace. Yet there is no consensus on the set of practices needed to safely use and develop the most capable AI systems, and high-level principles are not enough to manage these risks. What's needed is concrete technical guidance that developers agree is necessary.&nbsp;</p> <p>AISI is uniquely placed to lead on parts of this industry-wide effort to establish best practice. We house researchers with state-of-the-art technical insight on keeping AI secure during internal use, hold existing relationships with industry and other frontier AI organisations, and offer a neutral third-party home to establish best practice collaboratively. This role directly delivers on part of the&nbsp;Prime Minister’s September 2026<strong> </strong>commitment that the UK will work towards principles and standards that ensure the most capable AI systems are developed securely and with appropriate transparency. title: Associate Director, Influence - Burson
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a>&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>Burson is building three global Influence &amp; Social Centres of Excellence in the US, Singapore, and London. As part of our UK Centre of Excellence, which serves as the hub for the EMEA region, we are seeking an Associate Director, Influence to play a pivotal, hands-on role in scaling and evolving our Total Influence offer.</p> <p>This is an exciting opportunity for a mid-to-senior influencer specialist who combines strategic vision with flawless operational execution. Sitting within our multi-disciplinary capability, you will be the day-to-day strategic engine and trusted advisor across all agency practices. You will plan, oversee, and execute best-in-class influencer-led campaigns that earn cultural relevance, protect reputation, and deliver measurable business impact.</p> <p>As an Influence Associate Director, you will be a dynamic, commercially astute specialist and creative thinker, leading best-in-class, influencer-led content strategies and programmes across all agency sectors. Viewing "influence" holistically, you will provide strategic and practical counsel to clients and internal teams; from identification, vetting, and contracting to creative co-creation, paid integration, and measurement. Partnering with UK head of Influence, you will elevate Burson’s influencer marketing offer, inspire dedicated specialists, and upskill teams to deliver exceptional, measurable results.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p></p> <div> <h3>Grow: Commercial &amp; Sector Partnership</h3> <ul> <li>Strategic Influence Partner: Act as a trusted adviser to sector and practice leads, translating client and business briefs into culturally relevant, influencer-led strategies.</li> <li>Commercial &amp; Organic Growth: Partner with the UK Head of Influence and senior teams to develop winning pitches, shape commercial models and identify opportunities to grow influence across existing and new client accounts.</li> <li>Holistic Influence Strategy: Champion a broader view of influence beyond traditional creators, incorporating thought leaders, B2B voices, subject-matter experts and advocates across owned, earned, shared and paid channels.</li> </ul> <h3>Enable: Delivery, Operations &amp; Best Practice</h3> <ul> <li>Best-in-Class Campaign Delivery: Lead end-to-end influencer programmes, from discovery, vetting and contracting through to creator briefing, co-creation, rights management and live campaign delivery.</li> <li>Creative, Paid &amp; Performance Integration: Work closely with creators to deliver authentic, high-quality content while connecting organic influence with paid amplification, licensing, whitelisting and performance marketing opportunities.</li> <li>Governance, Tools &amp; Team Development: Ensure programmes meet ASA, CMA, IP and Burson compliance standards, while embedding tools such as CreatorIQ and GWI and upskilling teams on influencer best practice, cultural trends and effective ways of working.</li> </ul> <h3>Transform: Innovation &amp; Modern Measurement</h3> <ul> <li>Measurement &amp; Impact: Partner with data and intelligence specialists to evolve how influence is measured, moving beyond vanity metrics to demonstrate sentiment, cultural share of voice, reputation shift and conversion.</li> <li>Platform &amp; Innovation Leadership: Build strong relationships with platforms including TikTok, Meta, YouTube and LinkedIn, while testing and embedding AI and emerging capabilities through Burson's AI suite and WPP Open to improve discovery, reporting and workflow efficiency.</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven Agency Experience: Substantial influencer marketing experience within an agency, PR, or integrated creative environment, operating at Account Director / Junior Associate Director level.</li> <li>Strategic &amp; Creative Rigour: Ability to plan multi-channel content strategies that are influencer-first, with a strong understanding of how audience mapping and data inform creative platforms and creator selection.</li> <li>Negotiation &amp; Contracting Mastery: Deep practical expertise in creator negotiation, complex scope structuring, multi-platform licensing, exclusivity, and contract management.</li> <li>Tech Fluency: Hands-on proficiency with dedicated influencer tech platforms (specifically CreatorIQ) and consumer research tools (such as GWI).</li> <li>Collaborative Leadership: A natural relationship-builder who can seamlessly partner with cross-functional teams (strategy, creative, earned media, paid, data) and mentor junior talent.</li> <li>Client Advisory Skills: Calm, authoritative client-handling skills with the ability to articulate the strategic value of influencer marketing to both senior brand marketers and communications directors.</li> <li>Commercial Acumen: Experience building accurate scopes of work, production budgets, talent fees, and pitch responses that protect agency margins and client ROI.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Burson UK was named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026!</strong></p> <p><strong>#LI-CY1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our &nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Expression of Interest – Contractor Engagement – Bridge and Structures Inspectors
description: <p><strong>About BakerHicks</strong></p> <p>BakerHicks is a leading design, engineering and project delivery consultancy, delivering complex infrastructure, industrial and built environment projects across the UK and Europe.</p> <p>Our Infrastructure team supports a wide range of clients and frameworks, providing specialist engineering, inspection, surveying and asset management services. As our project portfolio continues to grow, we are expanding our network of trusted contractors to support current and future bridge inspection requirements across the UK.</p> <p>Our strength lies in our collaborative approach, technical excellence, and ability to mobilise the right expertise at pace to support our clients’ requirements.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Our Bridges Team</strong></p> <p>At BakerHicks, our Bridges Team delivers expert engineering solutions across the full lifecycle of bridge and structures projects, from inspection and assessment through to design, refurbishment, strengthening, and replacement works. Our engineers work on a diverse portfolio of assets including highway bridges, railway bridges, footbridges, retaining structures, culverts, and other critical infrastructure across the UK.</p> <p>We combine technical excellence with a practical, collaborative approach, working closely with clients, asset owners, local authorities, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams to develop safe, sustainable, and cost-effective solutions. Our experience spans inspections, structural assessments, repair schemes, asset management programmes, and the delivery of complex infrastructure projects in highly regulated environments.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p> <p>We are seeking Expressions of Interest from competent and experienced Bridge and Structural Inspectors to join our growing contractor talent pool.</p> <p>This is not a live vacancy tied to a specific project. Instead, we are building a network of pre-qualified professionals who can be considered for assignments as needs arise across our infrastructure portfolio.<br>Applications are welcomed from anywhere in the UK. Site travel will normally be required, there is no requirement to be based near a BakerHicks office.</p> <p>We are particularly keen to hear from inspectors based in Scotland, while welcoming applications from inspectors based in England.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p> <p>We welcome inspectors with experience in one or more of the following activities and environments:</p> <ul> <li>General inspections</li> <li>Principal inspections, including close-up examination and access equipment</li> <li>Safety, special and reactive inspections</li> <li>Inspections for assessment and monitoring</li> <li>Condition surveys (defect investigations and condition scoring)</li> <li>Highway structures on trunk road and local authority networks</li> <li>Railway structures</li> <li>Inspection and access planning, and reporting</li> <li>Team leadership and technical review by appropriately qualified Senior Inspectors</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Relevant asset types and construction forms may include:</p> <ul> <li>Road and rail bridges, including footbridges</li> <li>Culverts and buried structures</li> <li>Retaining walls</li> <li>Tunnel structures</li> <li>Sign and signal gantries, masts and other ancillary highway structures</li> <li>Structures over or adjacent to watercourses, including scour-related inspections</li> <li>Concrete, steel, masonry, timber, composite and post-tensioned structures</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Knowledge &amp; Experience</strong></p> <p>Applicants should be able to demonstrate the following, appropriate to the assignments sought:</p> <ul> <li>Relevant UK bridge or structures inspection experience, with a clear record of inspection roles and asset types</li> <li>Working knowledge of applicable standards and client procedures, including NR/L3/CIV/006 and/or DMRB CS 450 where relevant</li> <li>Ability to identify, photograph and classify defects; record severity and extent; recognise urgent safety issues; and produce accurate reports and recommendations</li> <li>Ability to plan and coordinate inspection works, including access arrangements and traffic or rail control measures.</li> <li>Knowledge of structural materials, deterioration mechanisms, structural behaviour and inspection limitations</li> <li>Experience with National Highways, Transport Scotland, Network Rail, local authorities or comparable asset owners and supply chains</li> <li>Experience producing inspection reports and condition assessments, including reporting using Bridge Condition Indicators</li> <li>IT Literacy – proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Depending on the assignment, the following will be required or advantageous:</p> <ul> <li>Current Bridge Inspector Certification Scheme (BICS) certification at Inspector or Senior Inspector level, appropriate to the work. Required where mandated by the client, including relevant Transport Scotland assignments</li> <li>Relevant BEng/MEng in civil or structural engineering qualification, or equivalent inspection experience</li> <li>Current working-at-height and confined-space competence, where applicable</li> <li>IPAF/MEWP, IRATA rope-access, PASMA mobile access towers, Ladder or other relevant access qualifications, where applicable</li> <li>Current Safe Working Near Water (SWNW) or other equivalent competence, where applicable</li> <li>Current Safe use of Trolley Equipment or Rail Trolley controller, where applicable</li> <li>Valid CSCS or other required site-access certification</li> <li>For rail work, current Personal Track Safety (PTS) and other role-specific competences; SSSTS or SMSTS for supervisory duties</li> <li>Network Rail Competencies STE2 – 7 as defined in NR/SP/CTM/017</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Why Register Your Interest?</strong></p> <p>By joining our contractor talent pool, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Be considered for assignments matching your competence, location and availability</li> <li>Build a working relationship with BakerHicks</li> <li>Work alongside experienced infrastructure professionals</li> <li>Support projects across a variety of sectors, clients and UK locations</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How to Register Your Interest</strong></p> <p>Please submit your CV. Our Talent Acquisition team will review applications alongside our Infrastructure discipline leaders, and suitable candidates will be invited to an introductory discussion.<br><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Engagement Details</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contract opportunities (Inside IR35 / PAYE engagement)</li> <li>Flexible working depending on project requirements (office/site/hybrid)</li> <li>Locations across the UK</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Many of the positions within our company are subject to security clearance or security assurance levels.&nbsp;The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of security clearance or assurance level for this role, in line with client and sector requirements.&nbsp;In some cases, additional nationality or residency criteria may also apply due to specific client or national security obligations.</em></p> <p><em>Further information on National security clearance levels can be found on the UK Government website: (</em><a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels"><em>National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK</em></a><em>)&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>About BakerHicks&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We’ve been innovating in design, engineering and project delivery since 1957 and operate from 14 locations for a truly European reach. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About us</h2> <div><strong>Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence<br></strong><br>PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace &amp; defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy &amp; renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.</div></div><h1><span style="font-size: 18pt;">What you'll do</span></h1> <ul> <li>Work closely with our simulation engineers and research scientists to develop an understanding of the physics and engineering challenges we are solving</li> <li>Work at the intersection of data science and software engineering to transform prototype implementations to robust production-grade model implementations, libraries and tooling</li> <li>Work with multi-GPU/multi-node distributed systems for training and inference at the scale of PBs of data and hundreds of GPUs</li> <li>Optimize the models and pipelines on all levels, from job scheduling down to GPU kernels</li> <li>Design and build scalable and robust infrastructure for end-to-end machine learning applications on cloud (CoreWeave, AWS)</li> <li>Continuously apply and improve engineering best practices and standards, coach your colleagues in their adoption.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 18pt;">What you'll bring</span></h1> <ul> <li>Enthusiasm about using machine learning for science and engineering, and especially in scaling such solutions to real-world settings</li> <li>Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment, learn and adapt quickly, scope, plan and training and serving ML models at scale</li> <li>Experience with large-scale data processing</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 14pt;">Nice to have</span></h2> <ul> <li>Domain knowledge in physics GCP, CoreWeave)</li> <li>Experience with C/C++, especially for computer vision, geometry processing and scientific computing</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>What we offer</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Build what actually matters</strong></p> <p>Help shape an AI-native engineering company at a formative stage, tackling problems that genuinely matter for industry and society. This is work with real-world impact - and something you can be proud to stand behind.</p> <p><strong>Learn alongside exceptional people</strong></p> <p>Work with a high-caliber, collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and operators who care deeply about doing great work, and about helping each other get better. We come from diverse backgrounds, but we share a commitment to operating at the highest level and addressing some of the most complex challenges out there. If you’re ambitious, thoughtful, and driven by impact, you’ll feel at home.</p> <p><strong>Influence over hierarchy</strong></p> <p>We operate with a flat structure: good ideas win&nbsp;- wherever they come from. title: Security Architect
description: <h4>Security Architect</h4> <p><strong>Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology &amp; Engineering | Type: Permanent</strong></p> <h4>Safeguard the digital future of financial services.</h4> <h4>The Role</h4> <p>We are looking for Security Architects to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable solutions for some of the world’s leading financial institutions. You’ll play a critical role in shaping security strategy, informing architectural decisions, and embedding best practices across cloud and hybrid environments.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role with opportunities to mentor others and influence major change initiatives, using approved AI tools, automation and AI-enabled workflows where appropriate to improve the speed, quality and insight of security architecture activities. You’ll apply human judgement and responsible AI guardrails to ensure outputs are appropriately reviewed and escalated.</p> <h4>What You’ll Do</h4> <ul> <li> <p>Develop enterprise security architecture strategies aligned with business and regulatory requirements, using approved AI-enabled tools where appropriate to accelerate research, analysis and insight</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead the design of secure systems, networks and applications across on-premise, cloud and hybrid environments</p> </li> <li> <p>Conduct threat modelling and risk assessments, define remediation strategies, and explore responsible AI and automation to improve the efficiency and quality of security analysis while maintaining human review</p> </li> <li> <p>Guide DevSecOps adoption by designing embedded security and controls within the SDLC, including appropriate guardrails, audit trails and escalation pathways for AI-enabled workflows</p> </li> <li> <p>Champion security awareness and mentor teams across engineering, architecture and delivery, encouraging responsible experimentation with approved AI tools where they can improve productivity and outcomes</p> </li> </ul> <h4>What We’re Looking For</h4> <ul> <li> <p>Extensive experience designing and implementing secure architectures across cloud and hybrid environments</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience designing solutions using Palo Alto, Microsoft or similar security ecosystems</p> </li> <li> <p>Deep knowledge of security frameworks and standards, such as NIST, ISO 27001, CAF and TOGAF, combined with experience designing Zero Trust Architecture solutions</p> </li> <li> <p>Expertise across IAM, endpoint protection, application and network security, with the ability to translate complex security concepts for technical and non-technical audiences</p> </li> <li> <p>A collaborative approach to working across multidisciplinary environments, with curiosity about AI-enabled ways of working and an understanding of the importance of responsible AI, human-in-the-loop judgement and appropriate review</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Bonus Points For</h4> <ul> <li> <p>Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, TOGAF or Cloud Security certifications</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience defining AI security architecture, responsible AI standards, guardrails or governance, including Generative AI or Agentic AI, within a regulated environment</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with security tooling such as SIEM, firewalls and IAM solutions</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with regulatory compliance such as GDPR or PCI-DSS within financial services</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, Java or C++, or experience supporting RFPs, mentoring colleagues or contributing to thought leadership</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Why Join Capco</h4> <ul> <li> <p>Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions</p> </li> <li> <p>Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture</p> </li> <li> <p>Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications</p> </li> <li> <p>Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services</p> </li> <li> <p>Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS &amp; Energy.</p> </li> </ul> <p>We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:</p> <h4>Benefits</h4> <ul> <li> <p>Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.</p> </li> <li> <p>Mental Health &amp; Healthcare: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, in-house first aiders and convenient online GP services.</p> </li> <li> <p>Family-Friendly &amp; Family Care: Maternity, adoption and shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause and bereavement, alongside 8 complimentary backup care sessions for emergency childcare or elder care.</p> </li> <li> <p>Holiday Flexibility: 5 weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday days based on your needs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Continuous Learning &amp; Extra Perks: Minimum 40 hours of annual training across workshops, certifications and e-learning, plus a Business Coach from Day One. Additional benefits include Gympass (Wellhub), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, Cycle to Work and dental insurance.</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Inclusion at Capco<br>We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know - we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration - a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.</h4> <p>#LI-DNI</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Pricing Analyst, B2B
description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years. Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again. Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again.

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again.

That is harder for us than for most, because what a client is worth depends on how their parcels flow through a network that's still growing. Engineering and analytics engineering build what you design.

Sales Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what a client or shop is worth and which signings sales should chase. The sales lead acts on your calls.

  • What is a new client or a new shop worth, when its value depends on where it sits in a network that changes every month? What would you build so sales knows before it signs?

  • Which signings become partners who do well with us, and what does that tell sales to look for?

  • The quarter's target is set. What has to close by when for it to hold, and what would tell you early that it won't?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide how sales values what it wins, and the result shows in what we sign next.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

  • Decide which Sales problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Sales decides: which signals count, what a client or shop is worth, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the sales lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Fraud Strategy Analyst at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

raw.description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay makes millions of dynamic, interconnected decisions across its network every day, and each one shapes the experience of the thousands of couriers who work with us. Knowing what any one of those decisions actually did is hard: couriers interfere with each other, effects vary from person to person, and the outcomes that matter compound over time.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. You'll lead causal inference at Relay from the start.

Causal Inference Highlights

  • A live, two-sided marketplace to experiment in, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

  • Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-term outcomes are the norm here, not the exception.

  • Four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

  • Your insights and models feed straight into Relay's network-wide optimisation.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Applied Scientist at Relay, you'll:

  • Set the standard for causal inference at Relay.

  • Measure how our decisions affect each courier, today and over time.

  • Shape how Relay experiments across a live, two-sided marketplace.

  • Adapt advanced techniques across causal inference, statistics and machine learning to Relay's problems, and see them through to production.

  • Partner with Operational Research to embed your insights and models into Relay's network-wide optimisation, and help build our research culture and voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Bring deep expertise in causal inference, experimentation and machine learning, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

  • Come from statistics, an experimental science such as biology or psychology, or quantitative research.

  • Have applied advanced techniques to real marketplaces or products, and owned the outcome.

  • Think in mechanisms, and let evidence guide decisions.

  • Are energised by open, interconnected problems, and know how to find the signal.

  • Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

raw.title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
raw.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Engineering team

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5, that looks like this.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 5 we'll also look for

  • Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

  • Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

  • Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Summary

We're looking for an early-career legal professional to help drive how Legal works at Dust. You'll shape and build legal processes and tools, and you'll get directly involved in a broad range of commercial legal matters, working under the supervision of Dust's lawyers. This role combines legal engineering and process improvement with hands-on experience in commercial contracting, including customer, vendor and partner matters. With a view to qualifying as a solicitor, the role may lead to consideration for an England & Wales training contract, subject to performance, business needs, eligibility and formal approval. A training contract is a potential pathway, not a guarantee.

What you'll do

Drive legal engineering and process improvement

  • Identify recurring legal bottlenecks and design better ways for the company to get legal support.

  • Translate legal rules and approved playbooks into practical workflows, templates, structured guidance and automations.

  • Build and improve legal workflows using Dust and other appropriate tools, including intake, contract review and approval processes.

  • Test workflows, gather feedback, document how they work and iterate to improve their quality and adoption.

  • Build appropriate controls into processes, including lawyer review points, escalation paths and safeguards for confidential information.

Get directly involved in commercial legal work

  • Draft, review and prepare redlines for a wide range of commercial agreements, including NDAs, SaaS agreements, MSAs, order forms, DPAs, vendor contracts and partnership agreements.

  • Support negotiation and deal execution with Sales, GTM and other teams, including participating in discussions when appropriate and under lawyer supervision.

  • Help identify legal, privacy, data protection, security and AI-related issues in commercial matters, and bring them to the right lawyer for review.

  • Conduct legal research, prepare issue summaries and help develop practical options for resolving contract questions.

  • Progressively take on more responsibility as your experience and judgment develop, while escalating non-standard or higher-risk issues to qualified counsel.

Build the legal team's capabilities

  • Help create and improve templates, playbooks, legal knowledge resources and tools that allow the wider company to handle routine work more consistently.

  • Use and improve systems that make matter status, contract obligations and key deadlines visible, rather than relying on manual follow-up.

  • Work with the General Counsel, Commercial Counsel and external counsel across a varied commercial workload.

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same three dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • Legal training, such as a law degree, paralegal qualification or equivalent experience.

  • Some experience in a paralegal, legal assistant, commercial contracts or legal operations role is helpful. We're also open to strong early-career candidates.

  • Clear legal writing, research and issue-spotting skills, with an interest in commercial law.

  • Interest or experience in process design, automation, no-code or low-code tools, AI workflows or contract-management systems.

  • Business-standard English is required. Business-standard French is a strong advantage, but not essential.

  • Willingness to travel to the US or Paris from time to time when required.

Attitude

  • Curious and motivated to develop as a commercial legal professional.

  • Organised, careful and discreet when handling confidential information.

  • A clear communicator who is comfortable asking questions, surfacing uncertainty and taking feedback.

  • Collaborative and pragmatic, with a genuine interest in helping colleagues move work forward.

Agency

  • Proactively identifies opportunities to improve how legal work is done, then helps design and build the solution.

  • Takes ownership of process improvements from problem definition through implementation, testing and iteration.

  • Gets directly involved in commercial legal matters and follows them through within the level of responsibility agreed with supervising lawyers.

  • Uses judgment to move work forward while escalating decisions that require qualified legal review.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

raw.description:

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We're looking for an Internal Control Manager to build and embed the internal control framework across our finance function. This is the team that owns the integrity of the group's financial reporting: close, reconciliations, AP, payroll and the systems underneath them.

There's a lot to do. As we scale across the UK and US, our controls need to move from something assembled ahead of audit to something that runs consistently every month. This role owns that shift end to end: mapping the process, identifying the controls, closing the gaps and embedding what's left into BAU. The core deliverable is auditability, control narratives, RACMs and testing protocols that hold up under external audit scrutiny.

What you'll be doing/impact on objectives

  • Map processes end to end across finance operations, including close, reconciliations, AP, payroll and the supporting IT environment

  • Identify key controls and carry out risk assessment across those processes

  • Run gap analysis and design remediation plans, then drive them to completion with process owners

  • Embed controls into BAU so they operate consistently month to month, not just in the run-up to audit

  • Build and maintain the control documentation set: control narratives, risk and control matrices (RACM) and testing protocols

  • Perform and evidence control testing, and track issues through to resolution

  • Act as the client-side counterpart to our Big 4 auditors on control testing and audit readiness

  • Partner with process owners across IT, finance operations, AP, payroll and close to make controls workable as well as effective

What we're looking for

  • Qualified accountant or equivalent (ACA/ACCA/CIMA/CIA) with a minimum of 5 years PQE

  • Direct experience in internal controls, SOX-equivalent control frameworks, or internal audit within a finance function

  • Big 4 audit background, either directly in external audit or via advisory/risk consulting

  • Demonstrable experience interfacing with Big 4 auditors from the client side on control testing and audit readiness

  • Proven track record across all four stages end to end: process mapping, control identification and risk assessment, gap analysis and remediation design, and embedding controls into BAU

  • Working knowledge of a recognised controls framework (COSO or equivalent) to structure control design and testing

  • Able to produce control narratives, RACMs and testing protocols that stand up to external audit scrutiny

  • Collaborative style: comfortable working across IT, finance operations, AP, payroll and close to get controls adopted

Interview process

  • Screening stage: an initial phone interview with the Talent / hiring team and a 15 minute online cognitive assessment

  • Remote Hiring Manager Interview

  • Onsite interviews with the Finance and Compliance team: 90 minutes

  • Follow up Final Stage Remote interview: 30 minutes

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: PreSales Engineer
description: À propos de Dastra Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la conformité et à la gouvernance de l'IA. Nous accompagnons des organisations de toutes tailles dans la structuration et le pilotage de leurs enjeux de conformité, avec une ambition : rendre des sujets complexes plus simples, accessibles et opérationnels. Dans un contexte de croissance et de développement à l'international, nous renforçons notre organisation commerciale et recrutons notre PreSales Engineer pour accompagner nos opportunités stratégiques. Ton rôle chez Dastra À la croisée du business, de la technologie et du conseil, tu joueras un rôle clé dans nos cycles de vente complexes. Ta mission : apporter la crédibilité et les preuves techniques qui feront de Dastra la solution de référence pour nos futurs clients. En véritable partenaire de nos équipes Sales, tu interviendras sur les opportunités stratégiques pour comprendre les enjeux techniques des prospects, démontrer la pertinence de notre plateforme et sécuriser leur décision. Tes missions Qualifier les besoins techniques : conduire les phases de Technical Discovery , analyser les environnements IT des prospects et échanger avec leurs interlocuteurs techniques (DSI, RSSI, équipes IT), en complément de la qualification business réalisée par les Sales. Démontrer la valeur de Dastra : concevoir des environnements de démonstration personnalisés, construire des cas d'usage pertinents et animer des démonstrations adaptées aux enjeux métiers et techniques des clients. Piloter les Proof of Concept (POC) : définir les critères de succès, organiser les validations techniques et apporter les preuves concrètes de l'adéquation de notre solution aux besoins du client. Sécuriser les cycles de vente complexes : répondre aux questions d'architecture, d'intégration, de sécurité et de configuration (SSO, API, interconnexions, MCP...) et lever les objections techniques des prospects. Contribuer activement aux appels d'offres (RFP) : participer à l'élaboration des réponses fonctionnelles, à la définition des plans de déploiement et à la préparation des démonstrations, jusqu'aux soutenances auprès des clients. Assurer la continuité entre avant-vente et déploiement : collaborer avec les équipes Sales, Produit, Customer Success et Professional Services pour cadrer les besoins et garantir une transmission technique structurée après signature. Tu contribueras également à l'amélioration continue de nos pratiques avant-vente, de nos démonstrations et de notre documentation technique. Le profil que nous recherchons Tu disposes d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en avant-vente technique , idéalement en tant que PreSales Engineer, Sales Engineer ou Solution Consultant, dans un environnement SaaS B2B . Tu as l'habitude d'accompagner des cycles de vente complexes auprès de grands comptes , avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques exigeants. Tu possèdes une solide compréhension des architectures SaaS, des intégrations, des problématiques de sécurité et des environnements IT. Tu connais les enjeux de Privacy, conformité, GRC ou cybersécurité , et sais les traduire en solutions concrètes pour tes clients. Tu combines expertise technique, sens commercial et excellente communication : tu sais vulgariser des sujets complexes, convaincre et adapter ton discours à tes interlocuteurs. Tu fais preuve d'agilité intellectuelle, de pédagogie, de pragmatisme et de sang-froid, y compris lors de démonstrations en direct. Tu maîtrises parfaitement le français et l'anglais (niveau C2) pour évoluer dans un environnement international. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un rôle stratégique : intervenir directement sur les opportunités à fort potentiel et contribuer à la croissance de Dastra. Un environnement stimulant : évoluer à l'intersection du SaaS, de la protection des données, de la cybersécurité et de l'intelligence artificielle. Une fonction en construction : rejoindre une organisation avant-vente en cours de structuration, avec l'opportunité de contribuer à son développement. Une collaboration transverse : travailler au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, Produit, Customer Success et Professional Services. Conditions & avantages Package salariale brut /an selon profil et expérience Paris 1er / Télétravail hybride (3j sur site) 5 semaines de congés payés + 10 jours de RTT TR+ mutuelle d’entreprise 1 séminaire par an + des teams buildings Tu aimes autant comprendre le produit que convaincre de sa valeur ? Tu sais transformer une problématique technique complexe en une solution claire et crédible pour un client ? Alors, rencontrons-nous ! Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
